'''Thug''' was a [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] who served as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]],<ref name="CCG" /> a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who operated out of a [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> A member of the [[Groogrun]] clan,<ref name="EGWT" /> Thug served alongside [[Thok (Gamorrean guard)/Legends|Thok]], a Gamorrean who left [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba's criminal empire]]<ref name="Barely Tolerable">{{SW|url=news/barely-tolerable-alien-henchmen-of-the-empire-part-2|series=Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="note">{{SW|url=news/barely-tolerable-alien-henchmen-of-the-empire-part-2|series=Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}} mentions Thug was serving [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] along with [[Thok (Gamorrean guard)/Legends|Thok]], a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] who left [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba's criminal empire]] when [[Imperial Prefect]] [[Orun Depp]], who was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in ''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]'', was still alive. ''Tatooine Manhunt'' has [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|X-34 landspeeder]] for sale before Depp's death, and {{Film|IV}} depicts Skywalker selling his [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] in events dated to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. ''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]'' mentions [[Eugene Talmont]] became [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prefect/Legends|Prefect]] after Depp's death, with ''[[Star Wars Missions 5: The Hunt for Han Solo]]'' having Talmont as prefect a "few [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]]" after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''The New Essential Chronology'' dates to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> Thug was still working for Jabba when Thok returned to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] service following the latter Gamorrean's role in assisting the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] in a [[Battle of Imperial Center|coup]] against [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] that took place in<ref name="Barely Tolerable" /> [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC note">{{CCG|set=Reflections III|cardname=Thok & Thug}} is concurrent to the [[Siege of Jabba's Palace]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Thug was one of the Gamorrean guards present in Jabba's Palace at around the [[Time/Legends|time]]<ref name="CCG" /> that several [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|arrived]] in attempt to free their ally, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who was held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] in the palace.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Thug wielded a double-bladed [[Gamorrean war ax/Legends|Gamorrean Battleaxe]], and was one of the many whom Jabba considered big, strong, and dumb guards who were good individually, and better when utilized in numbers.<ref name="CCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thug was created onset for [[1983]]'s {{Film|VI}}, the third film of the [[original trilogy]]. A photo of the Gamorrean was included in the [[1998]] ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' CD-ROM,<ref name="BtM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> although [[in-universe]] it is unclear if the character is in the film.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Thug was first named in [[2001]], for the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game's]] ''[[Reflections III]]'' expansion set.<ref name="CCG" />
